description.zh: 侧栏导航新增「置顶」入口（带数量角标）：点一下就地展开置顶会话浮层，点会话立即切换，行尾可取消置顶；也可从浮层底部进入完整页面。
description.en: Adds a Pinned entry with a count badge to the sidebar navigation: one click expands a floating list of pinned sessions, one click switches to a session, per-row unpin, and a full page from the list footer.
